About This Creation

The crowning glory of royal Indian brides. Hand-wrought in 22K gold with uncut Jadau stones, carved emerald beads, and cascading seed pearls. Designed to frame the bride's hairline gracefully with a coordinating side crescent Passa (Jhoomar).

  • Complete bridal hair ensemble: Dual-tier Mathapatti + Side Crescent Passa
  • Cascading natural seed pearls and green enamel drops
  • Multiple concealed hairpin loops for secure, lightweight wearing
  • Handcrafted using 24K gold Jadau foiling
